# bamboo_whisk — realism QA

Changes:
- Added explicit physical schema, material-specific friction, restitution, COM/fragility and honest mass/density priors.
- Updated reproducible meshes, GLB/Blend, collision pieces and calibrated-instance transforms.
- Computed part COM estimates from collision volume; corrected Blender inertial origins without moving canonical visuals.
- Replaced solid tine-envelope collider with 320 narrow tine-segment hulls plus 17 hollow-handle pieces.
- Declared anisotropic bamboo-tine compliance prior; corrected pose and span.

Remaining:
- At least one reviewed instance/view remains below 0.75 silhouette IoU; primary-view fit does not certify all instances.
- Visible silhouette/occlusion mismatch remains; inspect calibrated overlay before training use.
- Tentative constitutive parameters only; runtime uses rigid proxy unless consumer supplies a deformable solver.
- Mass, COM, friction and restitution are unmeasured priors.
- No directly observed manipulation sequence verifies closure forces, thread pitch, flap limits or stiffness.

physics_properties.mass_basis: Constituent density times modeled thin-wall/part volume (flexible packages use shell surface area times film thickness), plus an explicitly unweighed contents prior. No product weight is established by the video.
physics_properties.density_basis: Dry bamboo apparent-density prior, moisture unmeasured.
physics_properties.centre_of_mass_basis: Density-weighted convex-piece volume centroids; overlaps and hidden thickness are construction uncertainties, unknown contents placed at the body centroid.

rigid_proxy_fallback.purpose: Default portable Bullet fallback; does not simulate compliance

physics_properties.parameter_status: Density-derived mass estimate and material-class contact priors; uncalibrated dynamics.

deformable.note: Constitutive specification and rigid fallback; no validated soft-body solver is embedded in glTF.

material_source.basis: Dry bamboo apparent-density prior, moisture unmeasured.

mass_derivation.volume_method: Sum of declared convex pieces; adjoining overlaps are not boolean-subtracted and are included in uncertainty.
